Name: Silos and Mill Repainted
Author: WisnuNug
Description:
[center][size=3]Did you know that silos and mills are buildings that cannot be repainted in Robin?[/size]

[size=3]But now you can repaint it!![/size]

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Download the mod and its requirements, put it in the Mods folder in the game directory.[/size]
[size=3]Play the game, go to the robin and do it.[/size]

[size=4][b]Uninstall
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Delete the Mods from the game folder.


[/size]Thanks you.[/center]

Manifest.Name: Silos and Mill Repaint
Manifest.Description: Makes Silos and Mill can be repainted.
Manifest.Author: WisnuNug
